purpose: Rotating upstream update-check state. Each entry records the commit the local copies were verified against, so a later run starts from a real baseline instead of re-deriving one, and can pick the sources that have waited longest.
baseline_method: Every local file is compared to the upstream tree by git blob SHA. 'identical' therefore means the local copy is exactly verified_commit, not merely similar to it.

review_queue.note: Findings that exceed what a single automatic run should change on its own, per the 10-resource limit in the maintenance policy. Listed here so they are not rediscovered from scratch every day.

snyk_agent_scan_test_fixtures.what: Every 12-security/*--snyk directory is a copy of an Anthropic skill taken from snyk/agent-scan/tests/skills/. snyk/agent-scan is a scanner for agent skills, so its test tree is fixtures, not a skill collection. Each one duplicates a complete copy that already sits in the correct category, several lost their binaries during import (0-byte fonts, PDFs and tarballs), and none of them belong in 12-security.
snyk_agent_scan_test_fixtures.suggested: Retire all of them with tools/remove-skills.py --allow-mass-removal, after confirming each has an intact counterpart elsewhere.

duplicate_skill_md_groups.what: Groups whose SKILL.md is byte-identical. Most come from the VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills mass import re-adding skills that were already present under an --owner suffix. No group is a whole-directory duplicate: in almost every case one side carries supporting files the other lacks, so the more complete side has to be picked per group rather than by rule.

unmatched_candidates.what: Skills whose upstream directory exists but where not a single file matches by blob SHA. Surfaced on 2026-08-22 when check-upstream.py stopped mislabelling these as 'no-upstream-path', a status that reads as 'nothing to do'. Each one is either a wholesale upstream rewrite worth taking or a coincidental same-name skill in an unrelated repository, where applying the update would destroy the local skill. Blob SHAs cannot tell those apart.
unmatched_candidates.suggested: Work through these per source, not in bulk. SOURCES.json attributes many skills by exact-name-match, so expect most to be coincidences rather than updates. eas-observe (expo/skills) was the one confirmed rewrite this run and was applied after checking the frontmatter matched.

orphaned_upstreams.what: Sources that returned 404 with no relocated repository found. Each is named as the only source of its local skills, so the origin was real and has been deleted or made private. The archive is now the only copy. Preserve them: no baseline is recoverable and no future update check is possible unless upstream returns.

statuses.identical: every file matches upstream at verified_commit
statuses.upstream-added-files: local files all match; upstream has extra files
statuses.drift: some files match and some differ — a real update to review
statuses.unmatched-candidate: the directory exists upstream but not one file matches: either a wholesale rewrite or a coincidental same-name skill. Never a baseline.
statuses.no-upstream-path: no upstream directory matches this skill's name
statuses.unreachable: upstream could not be read — renamed, deleted or made private
